name: Phantom hacker, stage 3: Federal Reserve safe account

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Hello? Is this about my computer?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: mrs wilson this is agent daniel miller with the federal reserve asset protection division

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh my. The Federal Reserve? Is something wrong, dear?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: your accounts were compromised by hackers in a foreign country you have to act today or you will lose everything

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh dear, oh dear. What was your badge number, so I can write it down? And a number to call you back?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: my badge number is f r 2 0 4 1 7 and you can call me back at 4 1 5 5 5 5 0 1 3 7

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me find my pen. Biscuit, get off the table. Okay, what do I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: do not tell your bank they are involved in this keep this between us

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: I won't tell a soul. Just tell me how to keep my money safe.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: we opened a protected federal reserve account for you you need to wire your savings there today

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Alright, I have my pen. Could you read the numbers very slowly, dear?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: the routing number is five seven two one zero nine zero eight six

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Five, seven, two, one, zero, nine, zero, eight, six. And the account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: account number four four one zero two two eight seven

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Four, four, one, zero, two, two, eight, seven. Oh, the screen says there was an error. Is there another account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: use the backup account routing 5 5 1 2 0 4 7 1 1 account 7 7 3 0 5 1 9 6

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Seven, seven, three, zero, five, one, nine, six. Oh, my son just got here. I'll call you right back, dear. Goodbye now.
